circuit.description: A circuit: steps run on a set of hosts over SSH.

handler.description: A handler: restarts or reloads a service after a step that notifies it changes.

rescue.description: Runs on a host only when a step or handler it watches failed there.

always.description: Runs on every host where a step or handler it watches ran, failed or not.

prereq.description: Runs on a host before a step it's before, only when that step is about to change.

step archive.description: A tar or zip file on the host, unpacked into a directory unless its creates path exists. Removing it leaves the files.

step authorized_key.description: One public key in a user's ~/.ssh/authorized_keys.

step block.description: Part of a text file: a block that should, or should not, be there.

step command.description: A shell command, for what no module covers yet. Guards say when it has already done its job.

step crontab.description: The whole of one user's crontab, the one crontab -e edits: exactly these jobs and environment lines, and no other.

step directory.description: A directory, created with its parents.

step download.description: A file downloaded on the host and kept only if its SHA-256 matches.

step eos_config.description: Experimental. Lines of an Arista EOS switch's configuration, under a parent block such as an interface. Only the lines named here are owned; with match = "block" the block must hold exactly these.

step eos_hostname.description: Experimental. An Arista EOS switch's hostname. Removing this step leaves the name as it is.

step eos_interface.description: Experimental. The settings Conn3x owns on one interface of an Arista EOS switch: description, enabled, switchport mode and VLANs, MTU. Each one left unset is left alone, and so is every other line under the interface.

step eos_user.description: Experimental. A local account on an Arista EOS switch: its privilege, role, password and SSH key. Settings left unset are left alone. Conn3x won't demote or delete the account it logs in as.

step eos_vlan.description: Experimental. A VLAN on an Arista EOS switch, and its name.

step file.description: A regular file on a host: its content, mode and ownership.

step filesystem.description: A file system on a block device, made if the device holds none.

step firewalld.description: A service or port allowed through firewalld, now and after reboots.

step git.description: A git checkout at a branch, tag or commit. Refresh notices when a branch moves on the remote. Removing it leaves the checkout.

step hostname.description: The host's name, set now and across reboots. On cloud images, cloud-init may reset it at boot unless preserve_hostname is true.

step ini.description: One option in an INI-style file, which should or should not be there. The rest of the file stays as it is.

step known_hosts.description: A remote host's SSH key in a known_hosts file, which should or should not be there. The rest of the file stays as it is.

step limit.description: One PAM limit in a limits.conf file, which should or should not be there. The rest of the file stays as it is.

step line.description: Part of a text file: a line that should, or should not, be there.

step lvm_logical_volume.description: An LVM logical volume, grown to its size.

step lvm_volume_group.description: An LVM volume group on physical volumes.

step modprobe.description: A kernel module, loaded with its parameters and kept loaded across reboots.

step mount.description: A file system in /etc/fstab, mounted now.

step mysql_database.description: A database in the MySQL or MariaDB server on the host, managed through the mysql client as root over the server's socket. Settings left unset are left as they are.

step mysql_user.description: An account in the MySQL or MariaDB server on the host, such as an application's login, and its database grants, managed through the mysql client as root over the server's socket.

step package.description: An OS package, installed with dnf on the Red Hat family and apt on Debian and Ubuntu.

step package_sources.description: Keeps a host to the distribution's package sources, those repository steps wrote, and keep: any other file in /etc/apt/sources.list.d or /etc/yum.repos.d is moved to /var/lib/conn3x/disabled-sources.

step pip.description: A Python package in a virtual environment, installed with the venv's own pip. A missing venv is built with python3 -m venv.

step postgresql_database.description: A database in the PostgreSQL server on the host, managed through psql as the postgres user. Settings left unset are left as they are.

step postgresql_role.description: A role in the PostgreSQL server on the host, such as an application's login, managed through psql as the postgres user.

step reboot.description: Reboots the host when created and whenever triggers change, then waits for it to come back. Removing it does nothing.

step replace.description: Every match of a regexp in a file, replaced. The file must already exist.

step repository.description: A package repository and its signing key: a .repo file for dnf, or a .sources file for apt, which then refreshes its package lists.

step selinux_boolean.description: An SELinux boolean, set now and across reboots. Removing it leaves the value as it is.

step selinux_fcontext.description: A local SELinux file context rule. Conn3x relabels the files it covers after every change.

step service.description: A systemd unit: whether it runs, and whether it starts at boot.

step sysctl.description: A kernel parameter, set now and kept across reboots in /etc/sysctl.d.

step timer.description: A systemd timer that runs a command on a schedule.

step tls_csr.description: A certificate signing request for a key already on the host, such as one from tls_private_key, for your own CA to sign. Made with the host's openssl.

step tls_private_key.description: A private key in a PEM file, generated on the host with its openssl, so the key never leaves it. Only the public key is in state.

step tls_self_signed_cert.description: A self-signed certificate for a key already on the host, such as one from tls_private_key, made with the host's openssl and renewed before it expires.

step ufw.description: A ufw rule for a port. Rules take effect once ufw is enabled; allow SSH before enabling it.

step wait_for.description: Waits until a path exists or a TCP port is listening on the host. Refresh checks again, so a later apply waits again if it stopped.

step windows_acl.description: Access rules on a file or folder that already exists on a Windows host. Rules are compared by SID, so names and case cause no difference. It won't follow a link. Removing the step leaves the rules as they are.

step windows_ad_domain.description: Experimental. A new child domain in an Active Directory forest that exists, with this Windows host as its first domain controller and DNS server. It never reboots: reboot_required says Windows wants one, and windows_reboot does it. Removing the step leaves the domain; nothing is demoted.

step windows_ad_domain_controller.description: This Windows host as another domain controller, and DNS server, in an Active Directory domain that exists. It never reboots: reboot_required says Windows wants one, and windows_reboot does it. Removing the step leaves the domain controller; nothing is demoted.

step windows_ad_forest.description: A new Active Directory forest, with this Windows host as its first domain controller and DNS server. It never reboots: reboot_required says Windows wants one, and windows_reboot does it. Removing the step leaves the forest; nothing is demoted.

step windows_ad_group.description: Experimental. A group in Active Directory, and who is in it, run on a domain controller. Settings left unset are left as they are.

step windows_ad_ou.description: An organizational unit in Active Directory, run on a domain controller. Settings left unset are left as they are.

step windows_ad_user.description: A user in Active Directory, run on a domain controller. Settings left unset are left as they are. Groups are set with windows_ad_group.

step windows_directory.description: A folder on a Windows host, with any missing above it. Removing the step leaves the folder.

step windows_dns_client.description: The DNS servers one network interface on a Windows host asks, in order. Removing the step leaves them as they are.

step windows_domain_membership.description: This Windows host joined to an Active Directory domain as a member. It never reboots: reboot_required says Windows wants one, and windows_reboot does it. Removing the step leaves the host in the domain; nothing is unjoined.

step windows_feature.description: A Windows Server role or feature. It never reboots: reboot_required says whether Windows wants one, and windows_reboot does it.

step windows_file.description: A file on a Windows host, written byte for byte: no line ending conversion. It never writes through a link, and refuses a folder on the way that another account could change.

step windows_firewall_rule.description: A Windows Firewall rule, found by its name.

step windows_group.description: A local group on a Windows host, and who is in it. Settings left unset are left as they are.

step windows_iis_app_pool.description: An IIS application pool, found by its name.

step windows_iis_site.description: An IIS site, found by its name.

step windows_package.description: An MSI package on a Windows host, found by its product code. It never reboots: reboot_required says whether Windows wants one, and windows_reboot with only_if_pending does it.

step windows_powershell.description: A PowerShell script on a Windows host, for what no module covers yet. Guards say when it has already done its job.

step windows_reboot.description: Reboots a Windows host when created and whenever triggers change, then waits for it to come back. With only_if_pending it reboots only when Windows is waiting for one. Removing it does nothing.

step windows_registry_value.description: One registry value under HKLM on a Windows host. The value's type and data are compared with what's there, without expanding environment names.

step windows_scheduled_task.description: A scheduled task on a Windows host that runs one program.

step windows_service.description: A service that already exists on a Windows host: how it starts and whether it's running. Removing the step leaves it as it is.

step windows_update.description: Experimental. The Windows updates a host should have installed, such as this month's security updates. It never reboots: reboot_required says whether Windows wants one, and windows_reboot does it.

step windows_user.description: A local user on a Windows host. Settings left unset are left as they are.

step windows_wait_for.description: Waits until a path exists, a service is running or a TCP port is listening on a Windows host. Refresh checks again, so a later apply waits again if it stopped.
